sections.title: Core Concepts
sections.content:
Think of **The while Loop** like building blocks. 

Every great program starts with small, simple pieces. This is one of those essential pieces!

• Start simple, then build up
• Practice makes it click
• Don't worry if it takes time - totally normal!

sections.title: Code Examples
Key Points
points: The while loop checks its condition before each iteration
If the condition is initially false, the loop body never executes
A sentinel value is a special input that signals the loop to stop
Always ensure the loop variable changes within the body to avoid infinite loops
The while loop is best when the number of iterations is not known in advance
